narrative.overview:
A dark instrument room where a living graph is the only light. The field is near-black and stays that way; the graph's green nodes are the signal, orange is the alert, and everything else is hairlines and readouts. The page feels calm and precise, with a hint of cinema from the canvas-drawn graph in the hero, but nothing glows at rest and nothing competes with the data.

Density is comfortable, not dashboard-dense. Sections breathe with generous vertical padding; inside them, information sits in hairline-bounded grids that read like labelled instrument panels. Depth comes from stepping the black up a tone and drawing a 1px line, never from shadows, except under screenshots and the transcript card.

Type does the persuading. Syne carries every heading and button; Instrument Sans carries the reading; JetBrains Mono carries anything the machine said or the user will type.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal field in three steps with 1px hairlines.
One signal colour (green) for links, primary action, live dots and good readouts; one alert colour (orange) for drift, failure and the third step of any sequence.
Syne display at 700–800 with negative tracking; mono for every machine string.
Pill geometry for interactive controls, 10–14px radii for panels, hairline borders everywhere.
Flat by default; shadows only under media.
Motion is restrained: 200ms colour transitions, 250ms lift on buttons, a living canvas in the hero, everything off under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Green means live or good; orange means drift or alert. No third accent, and neither colour appears as a large fill except the single primary button.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a green or white fill is always ink-on-green, never black or grey.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Commands, file names, skill names and transcript lines are JetBrains Mono, never styled sans.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Display weight 800 appears once per page, in the hero.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and hairlined at rest. Shadows exist only under media and the transcript; buttons, panels and tabs never cast one.

dos: Do keep the page background at Void and build depth with Void Raised and Void Panel plus 1px hairlines.
Do reserve Signal Green for links, the primary action, live dots and good states, and Alert Orange for drift and failure.
Do set every command, path and transcript line in JetBrains Mono.
Do use pills for interactive controls and 10–14px radii for containers.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by removing all animation and transition.
donts: Don't add shadows to buttons, panels or tabs; only media and the transcript cast one.
Don't introduce a third accent, gradient text, or glow at rest.
Don't put black or grey text on a green or white fill; use Ink on Green.
Don't use Display weight 800 anywhere but the hero headline.
Don't replace the hairline grid with floating glass cards.
